full_judgment: the vendors did not execute and register the kabala as per terms and conditions of the contract plaintiff instituted the aforesaid suit. Before the trial court the present petitioner filed an application under Order 1 Rule 10 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure praying for impleading him in the suit as defendant on the ground that he is possessing the suit premises and also carrying on business in the same as tenant under the vendors. His further contention is that as the vendor left for India as per provision of Section 92 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act the property vested in the Government by notification dated 16.6.1994.
